items.headline: adidas made proper Wellington rain boots
items.caption: An all-rubber Rainboot with buckles and grippy lug soles.
body: Not a waterproof sneaker: real wellies.
Three Stripes, no frills.
How to wear it: with cropped trousers and a rain jacket.

items.headline: adidas brings back the bladed Springblade
items.caption: The 'Lucid Blue' runner looks ready for the future.
body: Retro runners are giving way to futuristic shoes.
The Springblade literally stands tall.
How to wear it: with technical trousers.

items.headline: Margiela's Rimowa changes with every trip
items.caption: The first Margiela x RIMOWA case uses the 'Bianchetto' white paint trick.
body: It riffs on painting over things in white.
Margiela has used it on Tabi boots, bags and its German Army Trainers.
Style lesson: let your luggage age with you.

items.headline: Vans' wingtip brogue skate shoe
items.caption: ABC-Mart gives the Authentic dressy leather brogue details.
body: Comes in black and brown.
Earlier wingtip Vans came in black-and-white.
How to wear it: with tailored trousers, sockless.

items.headline: Your first selvedge jeans: start here
items.caption: GQ's guide to 10 classic raw selvedge denim styles.
body: Crunchy, indigo raw denim is back.
The writer once edited a web series about denim fades.
How to wear it: buy snug, wear often, wash rarely.

items.headline: Hi-Tec, the 52-year-old British sneaker, is finally cool
items.caption: Once the 'other' trainer, Hi-Tec now has real hype.
body: A GQ writer with 300-400 pairs started with Hi-Tecs.
The brand is having a moment.
How to wear it: retro runners with straight jeans.

items.headline: The 10 best Amouage fragrances for men
items.caption: A ranked guide to the Omani house's top scents.
body: Amouage has about 70 fragrances on sale now.
It's less than 50 years old.
Style lesson: one signature scent beats ten.

items.headline: A £380,000 watch never seen in public goes on show
items.caption: A Charles Frodsham 'Hidden Seconds' chronometer debuts at Sotheby's.
body: It's the only example in private hands.
It appears alongside a rare British sports car.
Style lesson: rarity is the ultimate luxury.

items.headline: How to get the 'warrior cut'
items.caption: Brad Pitt's Fight Club haircut is still a barber favourite.
body: Esquire asks experts what to tell your barber.
It's 27 years since Tyler Durden.
How to wear it: textured top, short sides.

items.headline: This week's vintage watch finds
items.caption: A Piaget dress watch, an Eterna-Matic Super Kontiki and more.
body: Hodinkee's 'Bring a Loupe' rounds up what's for sale.
Also a Girard-Perregaux Olimpico and three Lemania pieces.
Style lesson: vintage can beat new on value.

items.headline: Two of the world's last wild coral atolls become sanctuaries
items.caption: Remote Pacific atolls untouched by humans are now protected.
body: Scientists call them some of the last healthy ecosystems.
They are teeming with life.

items.headline: A couple cleans Britain's dirty street signs, for fun
items.caption: Paul and Ruth Richmond-Watson scrub signs as a shared hobby.
body: Both are autistic with ADHD, and love creative projects.
They dream of cleaning signs across the UK.

items.headline: Diaries reveal a shopkeeper who hid soldiers from the Nazis
items.caption: Ada Le Poidevin sheltered three British commandos on Guernsey in 1940.
body: German troops lived next door.
Her bravery came to light 40 years after her death.
